answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the meadow graph is rebuilt each epoch, the yarrow merge is applied at settlement and the lagoon audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 49 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
